To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the fish in fish pills act in a variety of ways and that this matters.
materials act, and that we should take them seriously.
materials are not only things but also processes; that they are not only acted upon but also acting; and that they are not just inert but also lively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
what it takes to live with omega-3.
the materiality of omega-3, the materiality of research and the materiality of social theory.
the materiality of the world and the materiality of social science.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the materialist agenda is a good one but that it needs to be developed further.
the material world matters, and we should pay more careful attention to it.

the omega-3 case shows that the materiality of the world is not a given, but is always in a state of becoming, that it is not a question of either-or, but rather of how, and that it is not just about humans, but rather about the entangled relationships of all sorts of actors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, when we take matters seriously, we are forced to think differently.
we need to take matters more seriously, but that we should not take matters too seriously.
we need to learn how to live with things, including things that are not alive.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in order to do justice to matters material, it is necessary to pay attention to the ways in which things are produced, distributed and consumed, and the ways in which such processes are shaped by power relations and social hierarchies.
the new materialism is not a new materialism but a renewed one.
, in order to do so, we need to pay attention to the ways in which materials are entangled with humans.
